data.gender_notes: Avril is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: April, or the month of rebirth
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘avrils’, meaning ‘April’. The name is also associated with the month of April, a time of rebirth and renewal. In Christianity, Avril can symbolize the resurrection of new life. The name Avril carries the meaning “April, or the month of rebirth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Avril usually hope their child will grow to embody april, or the month of rebirth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Avril belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “April, or the month of rebirth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avril total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אביל
in_hebrew.meaning: אביל הוא שם שפירושו פתיחה או האביב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אביל הוא שם שמקורו בעברית ופירושו 'פתיחה' או 'האביב'. הוא קשור למושג של התחדשות ותחילת חיים חדשים, ומשמש לעתים קרובות כסמל לתקופת האביב והפריחה.

in_greek.name: Αβρίλ
in_greek.meaning: Αβρίλ σημαίνει την άνοιξη ή το άνοιγμα
in_greek.long_meaning: Αβρίλ είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από τη Γαλλία και σημαίνει 'άνοιξη' ή 'άνοιγμα'. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την εποχή της ανανέωσης και της νέας ζωής, και συχνά χρησιμοποιείται ως σύμβολο για την περίοδο της άνοιξης και της ανθοφορίας.

in_latin.name: Avril
in_latin.long_meaning: Avril is a name derived from the Latin word 'aperire', meaning 'to open'. It is associated with the month of April, which is a time of renewal and new life in the Christian tradition. The name Avril symbolizes the beginning of spring and the opening of new possibilities.

in_english.name: Avril
in_english.long_meaning: Avril is a Christian name that originates from the Latin word 'aperire', meaning 'to open'. It is associated with the month of April, which is a time of renewal and new life in the Christian tradition. The name Avril symbolizes the beginning of spring and the opening of new possibilities.
